title.rendered: Top-Ranked IB Schools In Dubai With The Best Rankings (2025)

content.rendered:
Embarking on the journey of education in Dubai often means navigating through a plethora of schooling options, each promising excellence and a bright future. For those seeking a globally recognized education, International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum schools in Dubai stand out as beacons of academic rigor and holistic learning.

In this guide, we’ll explore the top 15 IB curriculum schools in Dubai for 2026, offering insights into their unique features, academic offerings, and extracurricular opportunities.

But the journey doesn’t end there. Recognizing the challenges students may face in mastering the IB curriculum, Ignite Training Institute stands ready to offer unparalleled tutoring support with IBDP tutors & IB MYP tutors.

Which Are The Top 15 IB Schools In Dubai?

It’s fair to say the right school can help shape a child’s future in the best possible manner. A school that not only offers the best education but also provides the apt exposure for wholesome personality development. The need of the hour is an educational center that prepares students for higher education from the beginning, and with that understanding, let’s get started. 

The following institutions mentioned below are pure IB curriculum schools located in Dubai. 

1. GEMS World Academy – Dubai

GEMS World Academy – Dubai provides a globally focused learning experience shaped by strong cultural diversity and deep IB expertise among its educators. The school hosts over 1,200 students representing more than 80 nationalities, creating a truly international environment. 

Its purpose built campus includes a 3D planetarium, Olympic size swimming pool, athletics track, recording studio, and a 620 seat auditorium. Students access more than 120 enrichment programmes, along with a dedicated Entrepreneurship Hub and Language Institute. 

The school also offers one of the UAE’s largest mother tongue programmes, supporting 14 languages and promoting intercultural understanding.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2008
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), Diploma Programme (DP), Career-related Programme (CP)
  • Location: Al Barsha South, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: 2 to 19 years (Nursery to Grade 12)
  • Name of Principal: Mr. Heath Monk
  • KHDA Rating: Very Good (most recent inspection rating)Fee Range: Approximately AED 42,271 to AED 123,442 per year (KHDA approved fees, 2025–2026)

2. Jumeira Baccalaureate School (JBS)

Jumeira Baccalaureate School provides a values focused international education within a diverse community of around 1,300 students representing nearly 90 nationalities, supported by about 160 staff and more than 50 spoken languages. 

Its 33,000 square metre campus features advanced science and technology labs, creative arts spaces, a 25 metre swimming pool, and extensive sports facilities. The school integrates character education into its IB framework and earned the Quality Mark Award from the Association of Character Education. 

Students achieve strong IB Diploma results above global averages, and graduates secure placements at leading universities worldwide. The school supports inclusion through French A and enhanced Arabic language pathways and offers Pearson BTEC courses alongside the IB continuum.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2010
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate PYP, MYP, DP, CP, with Pearson BTEC pathways
  • Location: Jumeirah 1, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years (Pre-KG to Grade 12)
  • Name of Principal: Mr. Richard Drew
  • KHDA Rating: Very Good (most recent inspection rating)
  • Fee Range: AED 43,325 – AED 91,840 per year (KHDA approved fees, 2025–2026)

3. Dubai International Academy 

Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills is the longest established IB continuum school in Dubai and the only IB school in the city rated Outstanding by the KHDA. 

The school serves more than 2,700 students representing over 85 nationalities and is recognised for consistently strong IB outcomes, including a 100 percent Diploma pass rate and over $13 million in university scholarships secured by the Class of 2024. 

Graduates progress to leading global institutions, including Ivy League and Russell Group universities.

The 482,000 square foot campus features specialist arts and technology spaces, three swimming pools, four climate controlled sports halls, shaded outdoor courts, and a fully grassed playing field. 

With a 97.1 percent retention rate and strong Division 1 sports participation, DIA combines academic ambition with a deep sense of community and belonging.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2005
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), Diploma Programme (DP), Career-related Programme (CP)
  • Location: First Al Khail Street, Emirates Hills, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years (KG1 to Year 13)
  • Name of Principal: Mr. Hitesh Bhagat
  • KHDA Rating: Outstanding (most recent KHDA inspection)
  • Fee Range: AED 43,946 – AED 77,866 per year (KHDA approved fees)

4. Raffles World Academy 

Raffles World Academy is an independent co-educational IB World School and a proud member of Innoventures Education. Guided by its motto, “Towards Excellence,” the school places student development at the centre of every decision, encouraging learners to embody the IB Learner Profile. 

RWA delivers a personalised approach to education, supported by a dedicated Learning Support team that caters to students with mild to moderate learning needs as well as gifted and talented learners.

Students are empowered with a genuine voice in school life, contributing to a strong sense of ownership and community. 

The campus includes a 500-seat auditorium, swimming pools, a soccer field, a sports hall, specialist arts spaces, science and computer laboratories, and prayer facilities. A close partnership with parents further strengthens its vibrant, internationally minded school community.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2008
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), Diploma Programme (DP)
  • Location: Umm Suqeim 3, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years (Pre-KG to Grade 12 / Year 13)
  • Name of Principal: Mr. Timothy Roberts
  • KHDA Rating: Very Good
  • Fee Range: AED 33,544 – AED 96,337 per year (latest published fee range)

5. Uptown International School 

Uptown International School is a well-established IB continuum school with over 20 years of experience delivering international education in Dubai. Serving more than 1,500 students from over 80 nationalities, the school promotes diversity, global citizenship, and a strong focus on wellbeing. 

Its 57,000 square foot campus offers extensive facilities, including libraries for research and inquiry, ICT-integrated classrooms with full wireless connectivity, a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool, multiple sports pitches and courts, and dedicated arts spaces. 

Language learning is a key strength, with English, Arabic, French, Spanish, and Mandarin pathways. The school also prioritises inclusion through a structured support model for Students of Determination, combining differentiated classroom teaching, small group interventions, and specialist support when required. 

A healthy school cafeteria and a balanced extracurricular programme further enhance student life.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2005
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate PYP, MYP, DP
  • Location: Mirdif, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years (Nursery to Grade 12)
  • Name of Principal: Mr. Colin Gerrie
  • KHDA Rating: Very Good
  • Fee Range: AED 31,145 – AED 78,420 per year

6. Swiss International Scientific School 

Swiss International Scientific School in Dubai delivers a multilingual learning experience built around international mindedness and academic depth. Alongside its academic framework, the school places strong emphasis on language immersion, enabling students to develop fluency through bilingual and multilingual pathways that reflect its Swiss heritage and global outlook.

The purpose-built campus is designed to support both academic and extracurricular growth. Students have access to specialist science laboratories, innovation spaces, visual and performing arts facilities, a large auditorium for performances and events, and extensive indoor and outdoor sports amenities. 

The campus has been developed with sustainability in mind, aligning with recognised Swiss energy efficiency standards.

Boarding is an important part of the school’s identity. The residential programme is structured to provide a balanced routine that supports academic progress, well-being, and personal development within a supervised international community.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2015
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (Primary Years Programme, Middle Years Programme, Diploma Programme) with bilingual and multilingual streams in English–French and English–German
  • Location: Dubai Healthcare City, Phase 2, Al Jaddaf, Dubai
  • Age Group: Pre-Kindergarten to Grade 12 (boarding available for Grades 6–12)
  • Name of Principal: Ruth Burke
  • KHDA Rating: Good
  • Fee Range: AED 62,484 – AED 124,968 per year

7. Dar Al Marefa School

Dar Al Marefa School features a purpose-built campus designed to maximise students’ potential for learning. The school was designed by RCR Arquitectes, winners of the Pritzker Architecture Prize, and its architecture is intended to stimulate discovery, growth, and creativity. Light, shadow, colour, and geometric patterns are thoughtfully integrated to create an engaging and cheerful environment.

The facilities support a broad and balanced IB educational experience. Students have access to a well-resourced library building, a healthy food choices canteen, and a double-volume air-conditioned sports hall. Additional physical education facilities include multi-purpose PE studios, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a large floodlit sports field, and two outdoor tennis courts.

Academic and creative spaces include eight science laboratories, fully equipped ICT, art and design, and music studios, along with a 400-seat auditorium for performances and events. Shaded walkways and well-equipped playground areas enhance the overall campus experience.

Key Details 

  • Founded: 2008
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (Primary Years Programme, Middle Years Programme, Diploma Programme) delivered bilingually in Arabic and English
  • Location: Al Khawaneej 1, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: PRE-KG  to Grade 12
  • Name of Principal: Mr. Steven Giles
  • KHDA Rating: Good
  • Fee Range: AED 39,917 – AED 81,880 per year

8. Greenfield International School 

Greenfield International School is an IB World School offering the full IB continuum, including the Primary Years Programme, Middle Years Programme, Diploma Programme, and Career-related Programme. The school is part of the Taaleem group and serves a diverse international community.

The campus is designed to support both academic and personal development, with specialist facilities that include science and STEAM laboratories, visual arts and music studios, libraries tailored to different age groups, and a 400-seat auditorium. Sports facilities include an indoor gymnasium, swimming pool, and outdoor playing fields.

Digital learning is integrated into the curriculum, supported by a one-to-one device programme from the upper primary years. Language learning is also a key feature, with English, Arabic, French, and German offered as part of the academic framework.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2007
  • Curriculum: IB PYP, MYP, DP, CP 
  • Location: Dubai Investments Park, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: Pre-KG to Grade 12 
  • Name of Principal: Leigh Robin Kelly-Girven
  • KHDA Rating: Very Good
  • Fee Range: AED 33,680 – AED 80,960 per year

9. Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills

Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills is the longest established IB continuum school in Dubai and the only IB school rated Outstanding by the KHDA. As a full IB World School, it offers the Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), Diploma Programme (DP), and Career-related Programme (CP), supporting students from Years 1 through 13. 

The school has a strong academic reputation, with 100% pass rates in the DP, outstanding exam results, and graduates progressing to top-tier universities, including Ivy League and Russell Group institutions.

The campus spans 350,000 square feet and serves over 2,700 students from 85+ nationalities. 

Facilities include modern science labs, computer and design technology labs, specialist rooms for music, art, dance, drama, and language, fully equipped swimming pools, climate-controlled multi-purpose halls, a large outdoor playing field, shaded sports courts, a networked library, outdoor learning areas, and a Sky Garden.

Dubai International Academy emphasizes holistic development, offering extensive extracurricular and co-curricular programmes in leadership, athletics, performing arts, and community engagement. 

Students benefit from a supportive partnership between school and home, enabling them to build confidence, global awareness, and a lifelong love of learning while achieving exceptional academic outcomes and personal growth.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2005
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP)
  • Location: Emirates Hills, Dubai
  • Age Group: KG1 to Grade 12
  • Name of Principal: Anthony Blackburn
  • KHDA Rating: Outstanding
  • Fee Range: AED 43,619 – AED 82,475

10. GEMS World Academy Dubai

GEMS World Academy Dubai offers all four IB programmes and promotes international mindedness within a multicultural student body. The school provides a comprehensive education from early years through Grade 12, combining academic rigour with strong pastoral support. 

Facilities include innovation and science laboratories, performing arts spaces, sports complexes, and technology-integrated classrooms. Students benefit from a wide selection of co curricular activities and structured university guidance. 

The school’s focus on inquiry, leadership, and service learning helps prepare students for higher education and meaningful participation in a global society.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2008
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP, CP)
  • Location: Al Barsha South, Dubai
  • Age Group: Pre-KG to Grade 12
  • Name of Principal: Maryssa O’Connor
  • KHDA Rating: Outstanding
  • Fee Range: AED 47,862 – AED 105,000

11. American School Of Dubai

The American School of Dubai delivers an American curriculum alongside the IB Diploma Programme in the senior years. As one of Dubai’s longest-established international schools, it serves a broad expatriate community and emphasises academic achievement, character development, and community engagement. 

The campus features extensive athletics facilities, performing arts venues, science laboratories, and modern learning spaces. 

Students have access to a wide range of extracurricular activities, including competitive sports, music, theatre, and service initiatives, creating a balanced educational experience that supports both intellectual growth and personal development.

Key Details

  • Founded: 1966
  • Curriculum: IB Diploma Programme
  • Location: Al Barsha, Dubai
  • Age Group: Pre-KG to Grade 12
  • Name of Principal: Shari Camhi
  • KHDA Rating: Outstanding
  • Fee Range: AED 73,000 – AED 82,000

12. Dubai International Academy Al Barsha

Dubai International Academy Al Barsha offers the full IB continuum, including PYP, MYP, DP, and CP, for students aged 3 to 18, representing over 90 nationalities. The school emphasizes academic excellence, inquiry-based learning, student well-being, and international mindedness, preparing learners for higher education and global success.

Set on a sprawling 23-acre campus, DIA Al Barsha provides world-class facilities designed to support holistic development. 

Students have access to specialist science and technology labs, creative arts studios, a 400-seat auditorium, three swimming pools, a running track, a full-sized astroturf field, and two indoor sports halls. Sustainability and applied learning are encouraged through beehives, a greenhouse, and solar panels.

Beyond academics, DIA Al Barsha promotes leadership, service learning, and a broad range of extracurricular activities. Students engage in opportunities that foster responsibility, collaboration, and character building. The school’s modern, naturally lit classrooms and ample outdoor spaces create a positive, stimulating environment that encourages social interaction, exploration, and well-being.

By combining rigorous IB programmes, outstanding facilities, and a supportive international community of 1,800+ students, DIA Al Barsha empowers each learner to dream big, achieve their best, and make a meaningful impact in the world.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2018
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP)
  • Location: Al Barsha South, Dubai
  • Age Group: KG1 to Grade 12
  • Name of Principal: Salman Butt
  • KHDA Rating: Outstanding
  • Fee Range: AED 55,000 – AED 89,000

13. Raha International School – Gardens Campus

Raha International School (Gardens Campus) is a dedicated IB World School offering the full continuum: Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), and Diploma Programme (DP).

The school embraces a pure IB philosophy, delivering inquiry-based learning from early years through to graduation. The PYP nurtures independence and creativity in a play-based environment, while the MYP develops critical thinking and holistic understanding across eight subject groups.

The DP is the school’s flagship programme, combining academic rigour with extensive pathways in the Performing Arts, TOK, Extended Essay, and CAS. In 2025, Raha achieved an impressive average IB score of 33 points across a cohort of 141 students, with 73% scoring 30+ points and a top score of 44, reflecting both inclusivity and high academic standards.

The Gardens Campus features modern science and design labs, arts and performance spaces, extensive sports facilities, and outdoor learning areas, supporting a broad curriculum and co-curricular activities. 

Despite challenges with leadership and technology integration, the school consistently maintains strong outcomes, preparing students for higher education and global success while fostering independence, resilience, and well-rounded personal growth.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2006
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP)
  • Location: Al Raha Gardens, Khalifa City A, Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 4 – 18 years
  • KHDA Rating: Very Good
  • Fee Range: AED 41,960 – 66,030 (tuition fees for 2025/26) 

14. The Aquila School – The Villa, Dubai

The Aquila School, opened in September 2018, is part of the International School Partnership (ISP) and serves as its flagship school worldwide. It offers the English National Curriculum through IGCSE, alongside a dual-stream International Baccalaureate and British technical BTEC pathway at Sixth Form. 

The school emphasizes inspiring students to reach their full potential, fostering resilience, independence, creativity, and character. Learning is designed to be authentic, life-linked, and student-centered, enabling children to explore their passions and excel academically and personally.

The campus provides extensive facilities to support academic, artistic, and technological growth. Students benefit from specialized science labs, a STEAM/STEM lab, robotics and ICT facilities, art and music studios, drama and black box theatres, modern classrooms, EAL support, and dedicated study spaces for pre- and post-16 students. 

Outdoor learning areas, gardens, a farm, and performance spaces further enhance experiential learning. With this comprehensive environment, The Aquila School equips learners for success in higher education and future careers.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2018
  • Curriculum: British National Curriculum with IGCSE and International Baccalaureate/Post‑16 pathways (IBDP, IBCP, BTEC)
  • Location: Wadi Al Safa 5 (The Villa), Dubailand, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: FS1 to Year 13 (3 – 18 years)
  • Name of Principal: Wayne Howsen
  • KHDA Rating: Good
  • Fee Range: Approximately AED 48,673 – 77,876 per year

15. GEMS International School – Al Khail

GEMS International School – Al Khail (GIS) provides a premium education that prepares students for life beyond the classroom. As an IB World School, GIS offers the International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP, CP), equipping students with skills and knowledge to thrive in a global society. With a multicultural community of over 100 nationalities, the school fosters acceptance, communication, and global citizenship.

GIS integrates technology into learning through its BYOD programme and expert Digital Learning Coaches, enriching classroom experiences. Students benefit from modern classrooms, specialist labs, black box theatre, music and dance studios, and a library for independent study. STEM education is enhanced through robotics suites, innovation hubs, space labs, and a Centre of Excellence for Aviation, Aeronautics & Space.

The school promotes physical well-being with swimming pools, football pitches, multi-purpose halls, and outdoor play areas. GIS combines academic excellence, creativity, technology, and well-being to prepare students for a fast-paced, interconnected world.

Key Details

  • Founded: 2013
  • Curriculum: International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP, CP)
  • Location: Dubai Hills, Dubai, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 – 19 years(Pre KG to Grade 12)
  • Name of Principal: Nevita Pandya
  • KHDA Rating: Good
  • Fee Range: AED 52,415 – 79,488

Why Do Most Students Choose IB? 

International Baccalaureate, an internationally recognized curriculum is for students between the age of 3 to 19. It is strategically divided into 4 programmes – Primary Year Programme (PYP), Middle Year Programme (MYP), IB Diploma Programme (DP), & Career-Related Programme.

The following reasons justify why IB is an excellent academic pathway – 

  1. International Recognition: The IB curriculum is globally recognized, providing students with a qualification that is respected by universities and employers worldwide, enhancing their opportunities for international mobility and recognition.
  2. Admission To Top Universities: IB students often find themselves well-prepared for admission to top universities due to the rigorous nature of the program. Many prestigious universities value the IB Diploma for its challenging curriculum and holistic approach to education.
  3. In-Depth & Flexible Learning: IB offers a well-rounded education that goes beyond rote memorization, encouraging students to delve deeply into subjects and develop a breadth of knowledge across various disciplines. Its flexible nature allows students to pursue their interests while meeting rigorous academic standards.
  4. Knowledge Beyond Academics: The IB curriculum emphasizes the development of skills beyond traditional academics, including critical thinking, research, communication, and intercultural understanding. This prepares students for success not only in higher education but also in their careers and personal lives.
  5. Transforms Into Critical Thinkers: IB encourages students to question, analyze, and evaluate information critically, fostering a mindset of inquiry and intellectual curiosity. This transformative approach equips students with the skills to navigate complex challenges and become lifelong learners.

Ignite Training Institute – Best IB Tutors In Dubai For MYP & IBDP

Ignite Training Institute offers expert IB tutoring in Dubai for MYP and IBDP, providing personalized support through a customized IB curriculum. Certified tutors guide students across all subjects, strengthening concepts and building exam confidence.

IBDP students benefit from tailored lesson plans, curated study materials, and exam-focused strategies, while MYP learners gain a strong foundation, practical application skills, and structured e-assessment prep.

Learning combines interactive lessons, comprehensive study guides, and regular tests and mock exams to track progress and sharpen performance. Ignite also supports school selection, curriculum choices, subject decisions, and university pathways.

With over 10 years of experience, 1,000+ IB resources, 7/7 scores across subjects, and 2,000+ success stories, Ignite ensures small group training, structured learning, and continuous progress tracking for measurable academic growth and IB excellence.

FAQs

1. How Many IB Schools Are There In The UAE?

There is a total of 54 IB World Schools in the United Arab Emirates. Of these, 47 offer International Baccalaureate Diploma. 

2. How Much Does IB Curriculum School Cost In Dubai?

The cost of an IB curriculum school in Dubai varies widely but typically ranges from 30,000 AED to 90,000 AED per year.

3. What Is The IB Curriculum In The UAE?

The International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum in the UAE is a globally recognized educational framework offering a holistic approach to learning, emphasizing critical thinking, inquiry-based instruction, and international-mindedness.

4. Which Is The First IB School In The UAE?

The American Community School of Abu Dhabi (ACS Abu Dhabi) is widely regarded as the first International Baccalaureate (IB) school in the UAE, offering the IB Diploma Programme since 1976.

5. What Is The Age Limit For IB?

The IB Diploma Programme is generally for students aged 16 to 19. Younger students can enroll in the IB Primary Years Programme or Middle Years Programme.

6. How Is IB Different From Regular School?

The IB program focuses on critical thinking, research, and global perspectives, with core components like Theory of Knowledge, Extended Essay, and CAS. Regular school systems usually emphasize subject content and exams without these integrated core requirements.

Conclusion

Choosing the right IB school in Dubai can have a lasting impact on a child’s academic and personal growth. The 15 schools listed here offer world-class IB curricula, modern facilities, and strong extracurricular programmes to nurture well-rounded, globally minded students. 

From rigorous academics and inquiry-based learning to leadership, arts, and sports opportunities, these schools prepare students for success in higher education and beyond. 

Whether parents prioritize academic outcomes, innovative teaching, or holistic development, these top IB schools provide environments that challenge, inspire, and support students at every stage of their learning journey in Dubai.
